mentions.name: Ruby DSL for online surveys
mentions.description: A DSL written in Ruby for describing online surveys in a simple, readable, parseable language that is easy for both humans and machines to understand, with example usage and an implementation for building surveys.
mentions.problem: Existing UI form builders and Xlsform for ODK and KoboToolbox were not found to be easy for humans and machines to grok.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I wrote a DSL in Ruby to see if it could be done.  The language is mostly described at https://srp.solutions and some example usage and implementation at https://srpsurveys.com/
mentions.author: shaka-bear-tree
